steps.en: Install the skill into Claude Code
steps.zh: 把技能安装到 Claude Code

steps.en: Describe the biology, mechanism, audience and output
steps.zh: 提供生物主题、机制、受众和输出格式

steps.en: Collect sources and declare biological scope before drawing
steps.zh: 先收集来源并声明生物学范围

steps.en: Adapt the drawing kit into an interactive HTML figure with citations
steps.zh: 用绘图库制作带引用的交互 HTML 图

steps.en: Open the figure, use its controls and review the scientific claims
steps.zh: 打开图形、操作控件并审查科学论断

value.en: Readers can explore a biological mechanism instead of guessing from a static diagram
value.zh: 读者能操作生物机制，不再只靠静态图猜变化
